import cv2
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
from scipy.ndimage import distance_transform_edt, gaussian_filter
from pathlib import Path
import artifact_io

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
W,H=256,144
S=3
src=np.array(Image.open(ROOT/'first_frame.png').convert('RGB'))

def poly_mask(poly,holes=()):
    canvas=Image.new('L',(W*S,H*S),0);d=ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
    d.polygon([(round(x*S),round(y*S)) for x,y in poly],fill=255)
    for p in holes:d.polygon([(round(x*S),round(y*S)) for x,y in p],fill=0)
    return np.array(canvas,dtype=np.float32)/255

# Separate the original photographed surfaces, retaining their fine lighting.

pm0=np.clip((green-12)/42,0,1)
# Only the connected sheet of paper is retained.
binm=(pm0>.35).astype('uint8'); n,labs,stats,_=cv2.connectedComponentsWithStats(binm)
id=1+np.argmax(stats[1:,4]); core=(labs==id)
pm0*=cv2.dilate(core.astype('uint8'),np.ones((3,3),np.uint8))
pm=cv2.resize(pm0,(W*S,H*S),interpolation=cv2.INTER_LINEAR)
left_poly=[(-8,36),(6,33),(16,30),(22,27),(23,26),(31,25),(40,25.5),(50,28.5),(59,33.5),(67,38.5),(73.5,41),(74,43.5),(72,45.5),(66,46.5),(59,49),(50,53),(40,56),(31,58),(24,58),(18,56.5),(11,54),(-8,47)]
left_hole=[(28.3,39),(29.2,36.3),(34,35),(40,35.6),(47,38),(53,41),(58,43),(53,45.3),(47,47.1),(40,49),(33.2,49),(29,47.5),(28,44)]
right_poly=[(180,27),(188,24),(194,19),(197,14),(201,7),(207,3),(212,2),(216,2),(222,4),(228,4),(246,-3),(255,-2),(254,2),(249,4),(241,7),(233,11),(227,14),(223,19),(221,24),(217,27),(211,29),(204,31),(194,31),(187,29)]
right_hole=[(189,25.5),(195,20),(200,12),(204,9),(209,8),(214,8),(214,13),(214,18),(211,23),(207,26),(201,27),(196,27)]
lm=poly_mask(left_poly,[left_hole])*(1-pm)
rm=poly_mask(right_poly,[right_hole])*(1-pm)
# Sub-pixel photographic edge softening.
lm=gaussian_filter(lm,.48);rm=gaussian_filter(rm,.48)
tex=cv2.resize(src,(W*S,H*S),interpolation=cv2.INTER_CUBIC).astype(np.float32)
_,inds=distance_transform_edt(~(pm0>.92),return_indices=True)
paper_src=src[inds[0],inds[1]]
paper_tex=cv2.resize(paper_src,(W*S,H*S),interpolation=cv2.INTER_CUBIC).astype(np.float32)

# Reconstruct just the previously occluded tabletop from the visible wood below.
y,x=np.mgrid[:H,:W].astype(np.float32)
# Parallel wood grain is projected diagonally across the stationary table.
sy=np.where(y<68,y+76,y+44)
sx=x+(sy-y)*.60
# Reflected sampling keeps the donor entirely inside the supplied photograph.
sx=np.where(sx>255,510-sx,sx)
sy=np.minimum(sy,143)
donor=cv2.remap(src,sx.astype('float32'),sy.astype('float32'),cv2.INTER_LINEAR).astype(float)
# The exposure is a little brighter at the back of the demonstration table.
donor*= (1+0.055*(80-y)/100)[:,:,None]
occ=((pm0>.015)|(cv2.resize(lm+rm,(W,H))>.07)).astype('uint8')
# Remove the old object shadows as well as their silhouettes.
occ=cv2.dilate(occ,np.ones((11,11),np.uint8))
oldshadow=poly_mask([(63,46),(112,98),(130,94),(155,73),(172,36),(201,31),(212,33),(185,46),(167,74),(148,95),(111,108),(91,88),(58,54)])
occ=np.maximum(occ,(cv2.resize(oldshadow,(W,H))>.1).astype('uint8'))
blend=gaussian_filter(occ.astype(float),2.1)
# Back wall line and color fitted directly from the unoccluded first-frame strip.
edge=18-.074*x
wall=y<edge
wallcolor=np.empty_like(donor)
for c in range(3):
    valid=wall & (x<165)
    A=np.stack([np.ones(valid.sum()),x[valid],y[valid]],axis=1)
    p=np.linalg.lstsq(A,src[:,:,c][valid],rcond=None)[0]
    wallcolor[:,:,c]=p[0]+p[1]*x+p[2]*y
wa=np.clip(edge-y+.5,0,1)
donor=donor*(1-wa[:,:,None])+wallcolor*wa[:,:,None]
bg=np.clip(src*(1-blend[:,:,None])+donor*blend[:,:,None],0,255).astype('uint8')
bg=cv2.resize(bg,(W*S,H*S),interpolation=cv2.INTER_CUBIC).astype(np.float32)

Y,X=np.mgrid[:H*S,:W*S].astype(np.float32);X/=S;Y/=S

def ease(a):
    a=np.clip(a,0,1);return a*a*(3-2*a)

def tear_x(y):
    # Irregular cellulose fracture, continuous from the upper edge to the bottom.
    return 139.0-.215*(y-32)+.65*np.sin(y*1.91)+.4*np.sin(y*3.47+.4)

cut=tear_x(Y)

ml=pm*np.clip((cut-X)*S+.5,0,1)
mr=pm*(1-np.clip((cut-X)*S+.5,0,1))

    dl=-6.3*pull-11.8*retreat
    dr=5.5*pull+10.0*retreat
    # Crack runs from the notch down the sheet over about one second.
    pr=ease((t-1.35)/1.25)
    return pull,dl,dr,pr

def deform(x,y,t,side):
    pull,dl,dr,pr=params(t)
    w=np.clip((x-73)/(194-73),0,1)
    dxb=dl+(dr-dl)*w
    dyb=.8*pull*(1-w)-1.4*pull*w
    tip=32+65*pr
    r=ease((tip-y)/15)*ease(pr/.14)
    if pr>=.999:r=np.ones_like(x)
    # Once the tear passes a point, its local tensile stress is released.
    dx=dxb+((dl if side==0 else dr)-dxb)*r
    sag=np.sin(np.pi*np.clip((x-73)/122,0,1))
    dep=np.clip((y-22)/65,0,1)
    dy=dyb-12*pull*sag*dep*(1-.78*r)
    after=ease((t-2.58)/.4)
    tm=max(t-2.58,0)
    angle=(.065 if side==0 else -.048)*after
    angle+=(.048 if side==0 else -.065)*np.sin(tm*8)*np.exp(-tm*2.3)*after
    ax,ay=(73,44) if side==0 else (194,22)
    dx+=r*((np.cos(angle)-1)*(x-ax)-np.sin(angle)*(y-ay))
    dy+=r*(np.sin(angle)*(x-ax)+(np.cos(angle)-1)*(y-ay))
    # Short damped recoil/flutter, pinned at the closed gripper tip.
    bend=np.clip(np.abs(x-ax)/68,0,1)
    dy+=r*bend*after*2.6*np.exp(-tm*1.9)*np.sin(tm*10+(0 if side==0 else .7))
    return dx,dy,r


def inverse(t,side):
    sx=X.copy();sy=Y.copy()
    for _ in range(11):
        dx,dy,_=deform(sx,sy,t,side)
        sx+=(X-sx-dx)*.82;sy+=(Y-sy-dy)*.82
    return (sx*S).astype(np.float32),(sy*S).astype(np.float32),sx,sy

def shift_layer(mask,dx,dy):
    return cv2.remap(mask,((X-dx)*S).astype('float32'),((Y-dy)*S).astype('float32'),cv2.INTER_LINEAR,borderMode=cv2.BORDER_CONSTANT)

def render(t):
    pull,dl,dr,pr=params(t)
    layers=[]
    for side,mask in enumerate([ml,mr]):
        mx,my,sx,sy=inverse(t,side)
        a=cv2.remap(mask,mx,my,cv2.INTER_LINEAR,borderMode=cv2.BORDER_CONSTANT)
        rgb=cv2.remap(paper_tex,mx,my,cv2.INTER_CUBIC,borderMode=cv2.BORDER_REPLICATE)
        # Lighting changes slightly as the formerly curved paper pulls taut.
        _,_,release=deform(sx,sy,t,side)
        light=1+.055*pull*np.sin(np.pi*np.clip((sx-76)/119,0,1))*(1-.6*release)
        light+=.016*release*np.sin((sx-130)*.12+t*5)*ease((t-2.6)/.35)
        rgb*=light[:,:,None]
        # The very thin light-green fibrous fracture edge follows the sheet.
        dist=np.abs(sx-tear_x(sy))
        edgea=np.exp(-(dist/.25)**2)*release*.45
        rgb=rgb*(1-edgea[:,:,None])+np.array([139,199,111])*edgea[:,:,None]
        layers.append((a,rgb))
    tools=[]
    for mask,dx,dy in [(lm,dl,.8*pull),(rm,dr,-1.4*pull)]:
        a=shift_layer(mask,dx,dy)
        rgb=cv2.remap(tex,((X-dx)*S).astype('float32'),((Y-dy)*S).astype('float32'),cv2.INTER_CUBIC,borderMode=cv2.BORDER_REPLICATE)
        tools.append((a,rgb))
    # Shadows remain on the stationary table and follow the physical pieces.
    paperalpha=np.maximum(layers[0][0],layers[1][0])
    shadow=shift_layer(paperalpha,4.3,7)
    shadow=gaussian_filter(shadow,3.5*S)*.20
    tshadow=gaussian_filter(np.maximum(tools[0][0],tools[1][0]),1.2*S)*.19
    frame=bg*(1-shadow[:,:,None])*(1-tshadow[:,:,None])
    for a,rgb in layers+tools:frame=frame*(1-a[:,:,None])+rgb*a[:,:,None]
    frame=np.clip(frame,0,255).astype('uint8')
    return cv2.resize(frame,(W,H),interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA)

frames=[src]
for i in range(1,20):
    f=render(i/4)
    if i==1: f=np.rint(.78*f+.22*src).astype('uint8')
    frames.append(f)
frames=np.stack(frames).astype('uint8')
artifact_io.save(frames,ROOT)
Image.fromarray(cv2.resize(bg.astype('uint8'),(W,H))).save(ROOT/'.tmp/background.png')
